title: Alpenzoo Innsbruck Wildtiere
highlights: Einzigartiger Alpenzoo am Hang der Nordkette mit ueber 2000 Wildtieren des Alpenraums
Weltgroesstes Kaltwasser-Aquarium mit seltenen heimischen Fischarten der Gebirgsfluesse
Erfolgreiche Nachzuchtprogramme fuer bedrohte Arten wie Bartgeier, Waldrapp und Steinbock
Freiflugvolieren und Panorama-Gehege fuer Braunbaeren, Woelfe, Luchse und Gaemsen
kurzbeschreibung: As the world's only themed alpine zoo, Alpenzoo Innsbruck features over 2,000 alpine animals in natural habitats on the slopes of the Nordkette.
beschreibung:
The Fascinating Wildlife of the Alps

Situated on a sunny hillside above Innsbruck, Alpenzoo Innsbruck offers an intimate glimpse into the biodiversity of the Alps. Brown bears, wolves, lynxes, marmots, and sure-footed ibexes live here in naturally designed terraced enclosures.

Species Conservation and Display Aquariums

Alpenzoo is internationally renowned for its pioneering reintroduction projects for the majestic bearded vulture and the rare northern bald ibis. The display tanks of the cold-water aquarium reveal the secret underwater life of crystal-clear Tyrolean glacier streams and mountain lakes.
